decisions.reason: The email-to-SMS gateway was launched only in 2024 and has its own web page, so it is a visible commitment. It extends the firm's core messaging and integration platform at low incremental cost, and with little time on the market, weak results can still be read as a normal ramp-up phase.

The SMS-to-email gateway is the counterpart to Product B and supports the announced move toward integrated multichannel communication. Having just launched it publicly, management will keep it rather than reverse a fresh decision, even though Product A's withdrawal shows SMS offerings can be cut.
